author: New China TV
description:
Which moment touched you the most? For me, it was when she looked back one last time.❤❤❤

Recently, a public adoption and handover ceremony for six retired police dogs was held at the Zhaotong Public Security Bureau's police dog base in southwest China's Yunnan Province.🐕

While the other retired dogs left with their new owners, Tao Tao, a white-bearded police dog who had served for 11 years, ran straight back to her handler.🥺

Over the years, Tao Tao had carried out over 100 missions and helped police officers uncover many drug trafficking cases. She gave her best years to duty.

#retiredpolicedog #policek9 #workingdog #seniordog
title: ChinaToday | A retired police dog in China's Yunnan runs back to its handler one last time

author: New China TV
description:
On Dec. 18, 2025, the Hainan Free Trade Port (FTP) in China's southern island province of Hainan officially launched island-wide special customs operations. Now, supported by zero tariffs, low tax rates, a simplified tax system and the country's shortest negative list for foreign investment, the Hainan FTP has become a new frontier for China's high-standard opening up.
For foreign tourists and investors, what exactly do the special customs operations of the Hainan FTP mean? Let's follow Xinhua reporter Daria's lens to experience Hainan's sunshine and beaches, explore the rhythms of openness and development.
title: Amazing China | Island-wide special customs operations unlock openness for Hainan

description:
